title: Pall Mall — passing the clubs (linear cut)
learning_goal: Linear-cut stand-in for the Street View walk: know the 1,151 steps and see the three clubs in a row.

narration.script: From Savile Row, Fogg walks: five hundred and seventy-five steps with the right foot, five hundred and seventy-six with the left — one thousand one hundred and fifty-one, and he never hurries. We are on Pall Mall now, walking west through clubland, one of the first streets in London to be lit by gas, in 1807. Watch the left side: the Athenaeum at 107, then the Travellers at 106, then the palazzo with the tall windows — the Reform Club, 104 Pall Mall, by Charles Barry, opened 1841. Fogg made it 1,151 steps. We make it about a kilometre.
